title: Genshin Impact — Redcon (Player-POV What If?)
tts_note: Speech route for new episodes: intentional native audio → Chatterbox only with a redcon-owned approved sample recorded in this bible → otherwise MiniMax. Retry the same route once, then stop. Second-person monologue throughout. Long monologue (>80 words) → mandatory chunking into ≤35-word segments (see sound.md §1b).

format_overrides.note: Player-POV variant. Character = the Traveler (player). Each episode: one canonical Teyvat crisis, one cross-nation team assembled via gacha pulls, one divergence outcome made possible by a character the Traveler pulled.
format_overrides.structure: HOOK (clip 1, TTS starts, active mid-crisis) → TITLE CARD (clip 2, 3s silent) → CANON REMINDER (clip 3) → CHARACTER PULLED (clip 4) → DIVERGENCE (clip 5) → CONSEQUENCE (clip 6) → REVELATION (clip 7) → CTA asset

voiceover_hook.template_en: Imagine, you grabbed free Primogems from the link in bio, pulled [Character], and [outcome in one clause].
voiceover_hook.placement: clip 1 (hook), first TTS line — appears ONCE only, never repeated
voiceover_hook.note: Offer phrase is the causal setup: Primogems → pull [Character] → [Character] enables divergence. No second CTA mention anywhere in the script.

cta_clip.url_note: Use the universal Genshin CTA PNG as a full-frame 5.041667s end card with a real looped timeline. Do not use the older cta.mp4: it occupied the concat slot in episode 3 but produced no visible CTA in user review. Never use a Star Trek Timelines CTA.
cta_clip.spoken_cta_note: No spoken CTA in script — the full-frame CTA PNG end card handles CTA at the end.

player_character.name: The Traveler
player_character.gender_note: Default to Lumine (female, blonde twin) unless user specifies Aether. Both valid.
player_character.description: The Traveler — golden-haired wanderer from another world. Distinctive star-shaped hair accessory, traveler's outfit. Searching for their lost sibling across Teyvat.
player_character.note: No redcon-owned approved sample is currently recorded here, so new player-POV episodes use MiniMax. Do not pull a sample from another format or use a local fallback.

character_variant_episodes.note: One-off classic-character redcon episodes (canonical character + alternate-self, first-person monologue) — NOT part of the Player-POV crisis_rotation numbering above. Kept separate so future runs don't confuse these with the numbered Traveler-POV series or its do_not_repeat list.

done.alternate_designation: Ei, the Unmoved — Absolute Sovereign of Inazuma
done.divergence_point: Inazuma Chapter II, Tenshukaku — the moment the Traveler's intervention (destroying the Euthymia sample / the conversation with Ei) convinces her in canon to rescind the Vision Hunt Decree. In this alternate timeline the intervention fails; she completes the Decree by force, hunting and sealing every Vision in Inazuma with no exceptions, including her own loyal followers.
done.named_casualty: Kujou Sara — the Shogun's own devoted tengu general and shrine maiden, herself an Electro Vision-bearer, has her Vision hunted and sealed like any other on Ei's own no-exceptions decree, broken in the process.
done.downstream_consequence: Inazuma becomes a nation frozen in absolute stasis — no Vision-bearers, no dissent, no change of any kind — an eternity of silence rather than the canon's reconciled 'eternity within change'.
done.tts_voice: Chatterbox — no pre-existing Raiden Shogun/Ei voice ref found in games/genshin-impact/ at scenarist time; a raiden-shogun/voice-1.mp3 ref was sourced/created for the run. Cold, commanding, low-register reference, degraded stability/style (0.05/0.9) for the 'Unmoved' alternate register.
done.notes: Character-variant branch (not Traveler-POV crisis_rotation). Structure mirrors the Childe 'The Eleventh, Unchained' precedent: 1 title card + 6 story clips, ~35s story + CTA. Two character refs needed (canonical Ei, alternate 'Unmoved' Ei) plus a fresh Kujou Sara ref — none of the existing redcon-tagged Supabase refs (zhongli-seal, teppei, scaramouche, tartaglia-unchained) apply. IMPORTANT lesson: Scenarist's first monologue draft was 116 words for a fixed 6×5s=30s clip window — Chatterbox rendered it at 63.66s, forcing Editor into a 2.1x atempo stretch that sounded chipmunked. Had to send it back to Scenarist to trim to 66 words (~10-12/clip), re-render TTS, and re-assemble — final stretch factor 1.166x, in line with Childe's 1.17x. Target ~60-70 words total (not 100+) for future 6-clip character-variant monologues. Also: MiniMax Music API timed out generating fresh bg-music for this episode; Sound used the existing music/Dark/dark-crystal-castles.mp3 track in that historical run. Current rule: retry the same MiniMax Music request once, then stop the whole video; never repeat that local fallback. 2026-07-13: YouTube upload (v=60h1w0mUe3o) deleted post-hoc — first assembly forgot the standard genshin CTA banner overlay (banner-genshin.png, 'GAIN FREE PRIMOGEMS / LINK IN BIO') that the Childe episode established as the norm for this game. Re-ran Editor (FFmpeg-only, no new API spend) first with the banner on clips 2-3, then per user feedback narrowed to clip 2 only — confirmed via pixel-sample + visual check present on clip 2, absent on clip 3+. Re-uploaded as v=7L_ZCAJBc0s, same 2026-07-18T20:59:00Z slot. Lesson: this game's redcon character-variant episodes should get the banner (single clip, not 2-3) by default going forward — check for it before presenting final.mp4 to the user for review, not after upload.

Monologue trimmed from an initial 102-word draft to 90 words (Player-POV target 75-95) before TTS render to avoid atempo stretch.

episode_summaries.crisis: Dvalin's Abyssal corruption — Stormterror attacks Mondstadt (Prologue Act II)
episode_summaries.tts_voice: MiniMax Deep_Voice_Man (no Chatterbox sample recorded for the Traveler in this bible)
episode_summaries.notes: Player-POV offer-driven episode. The free-Primogem pull brings Baizhu before Dvalin attacks Mondstadt; Baizhu and Changsheng identify the poison beneath the Abyssal curse and guide Lumine's purification, after which Dvalin destroys the Abyss Mage's control and protects the city. Per the user's live Genshin override, universal assets were preferred regardless of format tags: existing universal Baizhu and Lumine sheets were reused, while an exact extracted canonical Dvalin model preview was uploaded byte-for-byte as the universal source at assets/genshin-impact/characters/dvalin/variants/canonical-model-source.png; no new generated character refs were created. The 95-word MiniMax narration rendered at 43.909s and required a 1.4515x effective scene-window atempo; target roughly 70-80 words next time for a more relaxed read. The first assembly technically concatenated the legacy cta.mp4 for 5.041667s, but user review found no visible CTA. The approved final replaced it with the universal branding/cta.png rendered as a full-frame 5.041667s end card. Use that PNG end-card by default for future Genshin Redcon episodes.
